author: Ari Koslow
title: Brent Rooker (knee) starts hitting, running progression
desc: Brent Rooker has started a running and hitting progression.
impact: It is a step in the right direction for Rooker. It is unclear if he'll have a chance to return before the All-Star break.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Michael Kelly designated for assignment
desc: The Athletics have designated right-hander Michael Kelly for assignment.
impact: Kelly was removed from the club's 40-man roster on Monday to make room for infielder Joshua Kuroda-Grauer, who required a 40-man spot to make his MLB debut on Monday. Kelly was touched up for a 16.20 ERA in five outings this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (hand) continuing rehab
desc: Zack Gelof is continuing his rehab.
impact: Gelof has started gripping activities. He is continuing to progress in the right direction.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jose Suarez placed on paternity list
desc: The Athletics have placed left-hander Jose Suarez on the paternity list.
impact: As a result, Suarez will miss at least Monday's series opener against the Dodgers. The 28-year-old has posted a 5.02 ERA in 26 outings this season, but his 3.89 xFIP suggests he should have some positive regression ahead of him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Noah Schultz (knee) to likely be activated Wednesday
desc: Noah Schultz is expected to be activated from the injured list to start on Wednesday.
impact: "He's feeling really good and it's very likely we activate him to start on Wednesday," White Sox manager Will Venable said. There should be an official roster move by Wednesday.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Kade Morris recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics have recalled right-hander Kade Morris from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Morris was roughed up in his lone appearance for the Athletics this season and has posted a 4.41 ERA across 14 starts for Las Vegas. The 24-year-old will be able to give the A's a long relief option as well as a potential spot starter while up with the big club.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Darell Hernaiz recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics have recalled infielder Darell Hernaiz from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Hernaiz comes up on a day when both Jacob Wilson (thumb) and Tyler Soderstrom (hip) were placed on the injured list. The 24-year-old has hit .237 with a homer and three stolen bases across 47 appearances for the Athletics this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Tyler Soderstrom (hip) placed on 10-day IL
desc: The Athletics have placed first baseman Tyler Soderstrom (hip) on the 10-day injured list.
impact: Soderstrom was removed from Saturday's game with left hip tightness and will indeed require a stint on the IL. The 24-year-old has had a nice season, hitting .242 with 13 homers, 41 runs, 41 RBI, and an .803 OPS across 80 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Joshua Kuroda-Grauer recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics have recalled infielder Joshua Kuroda-Grauer from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Kurado-Grauer will be recalled to take the active roster spot of shortstop Jacob Wilson (shoulder), who was placed on the 10-day injured list on Monday. The 23-year-old has hit .323 with seven homers, 76 runs, 44 RBI, 15 steals, and an .845 OPS in 75 games across Double-A and Triple-A this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jacob Wilson (shoulder) placed on 10-day IL
desc: The Athletics have placed infielder Jacob Wilson (shoulder) on the 10-day injured list.
impact: Wilson is dealing with left shoulder soreness stemming from a June 24 play at the plate. Despite being available off the bench in recent days, the 24-year-old will indeed need time on the injured list to heal. Wilson is enduring a sophomore slump that has seen him slash .277/.310/.386 with four homers and two stolen bases across 50 games this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Colin Selby (shoulder) to seek second opinion
desc: Orioles right-hander Colin Selby (shoulder) will seek a second opinion while continuing his rehab.
impact: Selby has been sidelined all season with right shoulder inflammation and hasn't made much progress towards a return. He will continue to rehab while seeking a second opinion and remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Max Scherzer (back) could throw off mound Tuesday
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Max Scherzer (back) is playing catch on Monday and could throw off a mound on Tuesday.
impact: Blue Jays skipper John Schneider said Scherzer is feeling good and is playing catch on Monday with tentative plans to get off the mound on Tuesday. He was placed on the injured list on June 17 with back spasms and had a cortisone shot on Friday. The team is hopeful for an early July return for the decorated righty.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Yimi Garcia (neck) resumes playing catch
desc: Blue Jays reliever Yimi Garcia (neck) is feeling better and has resumed playing catch.
impact: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Garcia is feeling a little better and is playing catch on Monday. The right-hander has been rehabbing from elbow surgery but recently experienced neck and nerve symptoms that put his status on hold. He remains without a timeline to return.

author: Nate Miller
title: Addison Barger (back) shut down from rehab
desc: Addison Barger (back) shut down for at least two weeks.
impact: Barger seemed to be drawing close to a return in his rehab from an elbow injury, but an MRI has revealed a stress fracture in his back after he felt soreness while hitting recently. After a solid breakout in 2025, the 26-year-old slugger has been limited to just nine games so far this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson expected to return before All-Star break
desc: Brewers manager Pat Murphy said he expects Logan Henderson to be back before the All-Star break.
impact: Henderson dominated in his first rehab start on Sunday. He will make at least one more outing on his rehab assignment.
